protocol.calibration_rule: build new current-CA 24-second calibration from common B0 delivered tracks; create future error labels only offline after acquisition; preserve whole scene blocks and align stored error trajectories by observed ego yaw
protocol.risk_envelope_rule: all methods keep the original 0.75 m plus age/memory prediction margin; B1 and B2 only add their independently calibrated risk term, without changing the physical sphere or 1 m safety threshold
protocol.calibration_block_rule: one score per complete calibration scene, taking maxima over its matured anchors and forecast intervals; 24 registered scene blocks, not a claim of 24 independent dynamic-obstacle blocks
protocol.risk_time_grid: 24 s forecast, 0.2 s calibration grid; final candidate and collision verification retain every original 0.02 s physical step
protocol.test_threshold_rule: test alpha is fixed at 0.1 before evaluation, regardless of tune results; tune curves use all registered alpha values without selecting a favorable test threshold
protocol.correlation_warning: many windows from one scene are correlated; window-level empirical coverage is not a finite-sample whole-task guarantee
protocol.online_information: only delivered causal observations; frozen offline ECP adaptation with no ACP online update in this pilot; any later update would require already matured and delivered labels
protocol.truth_information: offline calibration/evaluation and actual collision monitor only; never online risk scoring or candidate ranking
protocol.occlusion_scope: body-fixed narrow-FOV multi-obstacle cases can cause temporary loss; report measured loss counts, do not assert an unmeasured fixed dropout duration
protocol.terrain_negative_control: both terrain families contain no dynamic obstacles; risk-only methods must retain the same guidance and plant response
protocol.invalid_case_rule: record a factory/admission error against the original ID; do not retry seeds, change positions, or silently count a replacement scene
protocol.timing_scope: same 9 full candidate rollouts plus original coast fallback; planning wall time is measured and not silently converted to physical delay
